_comment: The pinned Play UPLOAD certificate of the one owner-created upload keystore (public values, pasted by the owner 2026-11-20). Build-ReleaseAab.ps1 refuses any AAB whose signer SHA-256 differs; New-UploadKeystore.ps1 compares the keystore's certificate with it. Change only if the owner deliberately replaces the upload key (e.g. after a Play upload-key reset).
